posts.title: Where Does My Poop Go? (Snob Edition)

human.text: Hey @grok, what happens to my poop after I flush? Also, how can I ensure my poop doesn’t fraternize with anyone else’s poop? I am a bit of a snob.

grok.text:
Your poop flushes into the S-trap, joins the sewer line, and flows by gravity to the municipal wastewater plant. Solids settle out, bacteria break down organics, it's filtered, disinfected (chlorine/UV), and the clean water is released to rivers or oceans—then evaporates and cycles back as rain.

To keep it from 'fraternizing': Install a private septic system or composting toilet on your property. City sewers mix eve
